statusDefinitions.observed: Directly supported by the bounded normalized record and evidence context.
statusDefinitions.candidate: A bounded observation that identifies a useful next check, without asserting cause.
statusDefinitions.unverified: A plausible interpretation that requires an additional source or replay before action.

review.selection: first error per label in three distinct qualifying threads; evidence radius 3; bounded context

observations.label: StrReplace
observations.safeSummary: The result identifies the requested historical tool name as unavailable in all three sampled threads.

observations.label: ExecuteExtraTool→Workflow
observations.safeSummary: Two sampled failures are preflight input diagnostics; one is a runner spawn/RPC failure. They are separate error classes.

observations.label: Agent
observations.safeSummary: The three sampled Agent failures report interrupted or exhausted model execution; each has later successful activity in its bounded context.

improvementQueue.problem: Historical StrReplace calls fail because the requested name is unavailable in the current tool view.
improvementQueue.evidence: 3 of 3 sampled independent error cases report tool_not_found; current source exposes EditFileTool as Edit through FilesystemMiddleware.
improvementQueue.nextCheck: Reconcile historical StrReplace with the current Edit registration and any compatibility alias, then replay a fixture before changing prompts or migration logic.

improvementQueue.problem: Workflow failures mix deterministic preflight input diagnostics with runner spawn/RPC failure.
improvementQueue.evidence: 2 of 3 sampled Workflow errors are preflight export/syntax diagnostics; 1 is a runner spawn/RPC error. All three have later successful activity.
improvementQueue.nextCheck: Split full-range Workflow errors by preflight versus runner/RPC category and add targeted regression fixtures for each path.

improvementQueue.problem: Agent error results may reflect provider or model-stream interruption.
improvementQueue.evidence: 3 sampled errors say stream interrupted or retry exhausted, with later successful activity; the SQLite record does not identify provider root cause.
improvementQueue.nextCheck: Join the same calls to provider/runtime attempt diagnostics by stable call/thread ID and compare model, provider, retry, and cancellation state.

improvementQueue.problem: A sampled error followed by success must not be treated as a permanent capability failure or as cancellation without an explicit cancellation event.
improvementQueue.evidence: All 9 sampled error cases have later successful activity; this evidence contains no cancellation event classification.
improvementQueue.nextCheck: Require an explicit cancellation/event source before assigning cancellation semantics or counting an error as an inability.
